card.label: H.R. 6644
card.summary: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act establishes and modifies federal housing programs and banking regulations to address housing supply, affordability, and regulatory hurdles. It creates pilot programs and grant initiatives for housing repairs, conversions of empty buildings, small-dollar mortgages, and manufactured housing without permanent chassis. It also adjusts environmental review rules under NEPA, alters bank investment limits, modifies the HOME Investment Partnerships program, and restricts the Federal Reserve from issuing a central bank digital currency.
